title: PenHelper
description: A QoL mod for The Pen prison server.
body:
This mod provides many QOL features for The Pen prison server.

Features include:
- **Stat Tracking** - See your money/shards/keys per hour with /tracker
- **Shard Goals** - Track your progress towards your next prestige with /shardgoal
- **Vault utilities** - Open last vault, vault pages
- **Chat Filtering** - Remove annoying chat messages, such as tips, levelups, haste and more!
- **Inventory Monitoring** - Ding! Your inventory is full.
- **Useful Keybinds** - minetop, dispose, ect.
